document:0:573:0.text:
<style="stress">Kraff's Will</style>
To whom it may concern,

Unfortunately, I suffered a <style="highlight">high-tier arcane backlash</style> during an experiment, leaving my body severely corrupted. Pursuant to Article 3, Chapter 7 of the Magical Safety Regulations, my remains must be placed in a <style="highlight">triple-layered sealed coffin</style> to prevent the corruption from spreading to others.

Warning: Do not open the coffin or perform any purification rituals under any circumstances. Ignore this warning at your own peril.

Please ensure the personal belongings on my desk remain in their original state and are handed over to my next of kin.

Lastly, if you wish to pay your respects, please bring a bottle of golden amber wine and a slice of mille-feuille cake to my grave. Hopefully, they can... soothe my restless spirit.

May Dura grant me forgiveness.

<align="right"><style="stress">Janne Kraff</style>
document:0:573:0.source_cn:
<style="stress">克拉夫特关于葬礼及事务处理的紧急遗嘱</style>

本人因在实验中不幸触发<style="highlight">高阶以太分解反应</style>，身体已遭到严重的虚空侵蚀。根据魔法安全条例第7章第3条，为防止虚空扩大波及他人，请在我去世后务必使用<style="highlight">三层特制封印棺椁</style>将我收殓。
切记：严禁任何形式的开棺和净化仪式，否则后果自负！
关于我工位上的私人物品，请务必保持原状，交由我的亲属保管处理。
最后，若念及旧情，请带一瓶金琥珀葡萄酒及巴克千层蛋糕置于我的墓前，好让这些能……安抚我躁动的亡魂。
愿艾雅宽恕。
<align="right"><style="stress">——让内·克拉夫特</style>

<style="stress">Research ID:</style> S-E5003
<style="stress">Research Title:</style> Automated Document Indexing and Classification Through Mana Resonance
Objective: The Arcane Affairs Office has been operating inefficiently, mainly due to the excessive time spent handling routine paperwork. This spell aims to use a low-energy mana field to automatically identify keywords in files and categorize documents by priority.

<style="stress">Observations:</style>
1.5 units of arcane catalyst provide sufficient coverage for all filing cabinets in the office.
By presetting relevant keywords (e.g., mana, border, research), the spell automatically sorts matching documents into their designated zones.

<style="stress">Side Effects:</style> While the spell is active, individuals in the vicinity may experience the slight discomfort of feeling watched. This is a harmless effect of mana fluctuations and can be safely ignored.

<style="stress">Conclusion:</style> This spell is perfectly viable. If implemented across all administrative departments, it could cut labor costs by roughly half. However, since most court mages, especially Dali included, still struggle to resonate with the spell's frequency, it is currently available for my personal use only.
document:0:576:0.source_cn:
<style="stress">课题编号：</style>S-E5003
<style="stress">课题名称：</style>群体魔力共振式文档索引与自动归类术式
研究目的： 鉴于魔法事务司行政效率低下，人工处理琐碎文书严重浪费高阶施法者的精神力。本术式旨在通过低能耗魔力场，自动识别关键词并分类加急公文。
<style="stress">实验观测：</style>
注入1.5刻度的奥术触媒，可覆盖司内所有的文档柜。
通过提前设置召唤词（如：魔力、边境、研究），术式可将对应纸张自动平移至对应处理区。
<style="stress">负面效应：</style> 术式运行期间，周边的人员会感到轻微的被窥视感，这是魔力波动的正常影响，无需理会。
<style="stress">结论：</style>  该术式已趋于完美。若推广至各行政部门，预计可节省一半的人力成本。然而，由于大多数宫廷魔法师（特别是像达利那样的人）抓不准共振频率，该术式目前仅限本人使用。

say:10:1711050008:1.female: If that's the case, then it all makes sense.

choice:12:0:1.female: This has to involve Cyran as well.

choice:4:0:1.male: And not just smuggling; there's also the matter of Gervan...
choice:4:0:1.female: And not just smuggling; there's also the matter of Gervan...

say:2:1711050101:1.text: By order of the Queen, we are here to enter the Hastings estate and conduct an investigation.
say:2:1711050101:1.source_cn: 奉王后之命，我等需要进入黑斯廷斯庄园，执行一项调查。

say:3:1711050102:1.text: Lady Evie, may I see your documents?
say:3:1711050102:1.source_cn: 尊敬的伊芙大人，还请出示相关的文书。

say:6:1711050104:1.source_cn: 现在，我们可以进去了吗？

say:8:1711050105:1.text: ... Of course. Please follow me. You, go inform Butler Meyard that distinguished guests have arrived!
say:8:1711050105:1.source_cn: ……当然，两位请随我来，阿莱，快去禀报麦耶德管家——贵...

say:2:1711053001:0.text: Lady Evie, your unannounced visits have been rather frequent lately. One might even call it discourteous.
say:2:1711053001:0.source_cn: 这不是尊贵的伊芙搜查官吗？艾雅在上，您最近无预约造访黑...

say:3:1711053002:0.text: Or perhaps you've taken a liking to the tea we serve here?
say:3:1711053002:0.source_cn: 还是说，您对黑斯廷斯家的红茶情有独钟呢？

say:4:1711053003:0.text: Safeguarding the capital is simply part of my duty.
say:4:1711053003:0.source_cn: 麦耶德管家言重了。维护王都的安全与稳定是搜查官的职责所在。

say:5:1711053004:0.text: As long as the leads point to this place, I will continue to visit as part of my routine.
say:5:1711053004:0.source_cn: 只要案件的线索指向这里，无论多少次，我都会例行造访。

say:6:1711053005:1.text: I trust that a noble family like the Hastings will understand and cooperate, yes?
say:6:1711053005:1.source_cn: 相信作为帝国的名门望族，黑斯廷斯家族一定会理解并配合的...

say:7:1711053006:0.text: ... It would be our honor. Oh, please forgive my rudeness. Is this the legendary mage Merlin?
say:7:1711053006:0.source_cn: ……这是我们的荣幸。哦，请原谅我的失礼，这位难道是传说...
say:7:1711053006:0.male: ... It would be our honor. Oh, please forgive my rudeness. Is this the legendary mage Merlin?
say:7:1711053006:0.female: ... It would be our honor. Oh, please forgive my rudeness. Is this the legendary mage Merlin?

say:8:1711053007:0.text: Might I ask what brings you here with Evie?
say:8:1711053007:0.source_cn: 不知您与伊芙调查官前来，是为了什么事宜呢？
say:8:1711053007:0.male: Might I ask what brings you here with Evie?
say:8:1711053007:0.female: Might I ask what brings you here with Evie?

choice_prompt:9:1711053007.text: Might I ask what brings you here with Evie?
choice_prompt:9:1711053007.source_cn: 不知您与伊芙调查官前来，是为了什么事宜呢？
choice_prompt:9:1711053007.male: Might I ask what brings you here with Evie?
choice_prompt:9:1711053007.female: Might I ask what brings you here with Evie?

say:10:1711053008:0.text: What? You're here for the young master?
say:10:1711053008:0.male: What? You're here for the young master?
say:10:1711053008:0.female: What? You're here for the young master?

say:12:1711053009:0.text: Evie produces the Queen's warrant with composure.
say:12:1711053009:0.source_cn: 伊芙将王后的手谕拿出，动作标准而庄重。

say:13:1711053010:0.text: This is a special investigation order signed by Her Majesty. We are to interrogate Gervan Hastings immediately.
say:13:1711053010:0.source_cn: 这是王后陛下签发的特别调查令。我们要即刻提审格墨文·黑...

say:14:1711053011:0.text: Preposterous! That "accident" involving the headmaster was closed long ago!
say:14:1711053011:0.source_cn: 荒谬！关于那位校长的“意外”，不是早就已经结案了吗？

say:16:1711053012:0.text: The young master has already received a fair judgment—fifty years of house arrest!
say:16:1711053012:0.source_cn: 格墨文少爷已经接受了最公正的审判！五十年的居家禁闭！

say:17:1711053013:0.text: Court mages personally sealed his room. He can't even step past that door.
say:17:1711053013:0.source_cn: 宫廷魔法师亲自在他的房间设下了禁制，他连那扇门都迈不出...

say:18:1711053014:0.text: The punishment is already being carried out properly. Why must you disturb a nobleman who's trying to repent?
say:18:1711053014:0.source_cn: 惩罚已经在神圣地被执行了，你们为什么还要在这个时候来打...

say:19:1711053015:0.text: Or has the Chief Justice's verdict already expired?
say:19:1711053015:0.source_cn: 难道大法官阁下签发的判决书，有效期只有这么短吗？

say:20:1711053016:0.text: That was the verdict for the "old" case, Mr. Meyard. But the law does not protect repeat offenders.
say:20:1711053016:0.source_cn: 那是针对“旧案”的判决，麦耶德先生。但律法并不保护双重犯罪。

choice_prompt:21:1711053016.text: That was the verdict for the "old" case, Mr. Meyard. But the law does not protect repeat offenders.
choice_prompt:21:1711053016.source_cn: 那是针对“旧案”的判决，麦耶德先生。但律法并不保护双重犯罪。

say:22:1711053017:0.text: Gervan Hastings is now implicated in a major case that threatens the safety of the capital.
say:22:1711053017:0.source_cn: 格墨文·黑斯廷斯涉嫌卷入了一起危及王都安全的重大案件。

say:23:1711053018:1.text: His previous sentence does not grant him immunity from a new investigation.
say:23:1711053018:1.source_cn: 之前的禁闭判决，并不能成为他逃避新一轮调查的豁免权。

say:24:1711053019:0.text: This is ridiculous. He's been locked away, completely isolated. How could he possibly threaten the capital?
say:24:1711053019:0.source_cn: 这绝对是无稽之谈！他被关在房间里，与世隔绝，怎么可能危...

say:25:1711053020:0.text: Without the Marquis' approval, I will not allow you anywhere near him.
say:25:1711053020:0.source_cn: 没有侯爵大人的首肯，我绝不会允许您二位接近少爷。

say:26:1711053021:0.text: Mr. Meyard, please think carefully. You are standing before envoys acting under the Queen's authority.
say:26:1711053021:0.source_cn: 麦耶德先生，请您权衡利弊。站在您面前的，是手持王后陛下...

say:27:1711053022:1.text: Obstructing us now would be seen as direct defiance of the crown and aiding a suspect.
say:27:1711053022:1.source_cn: 此刻阻拦我们，在法律层面上，将被视为对王权的直接抗命，...

say:28:1711053023:1.text: Are you certain the Hastings family can afford that kind of political risk right now?
say:28:1711053023:1.source_cn: 您确定黑斯廷斯家族能在这个敏感时期，承担这样的政治风险吗？

say:29:1711053024:0.text: ... Very well. Please follow me. The young master is in his bedroom, repenting for his crimes.
say:29:1711053024:0.source_cn: ……好吧。请跟我来，少爷正在他的卧室中忏悔罪行。

say:30:1711053025:0.text: But allow me to remind you both: Gervan Hastings is still a member of the honorable House Hastings, and you must extend the most basic respect.
say:30:1711053025:0.source_cn: 但请容许我提醒二位，无论如何，格墨文·黑斯廷斯都是尊贵...

say:31:1711053026:1.source_cn: 我们知道分寸，请带路吧。

choice:21:0:1.text: He's involved in a new case.
choice:21:0:1.male: He's involved in a new case.
choice:21:0:1.female: He's involved in a new case.

say:2:1711054001:1.text: Unfortunately, you don't have the right to refuse guests at the moment.
say:2:1711054001:1.source_cn: 很遗憾，现在的你没有拒绝客人的权利。

say:3:1711054002:1.text: It's you... Magister Merlin and Envoy Evie.
say:3:1711054002:1.source_cn: 是你们啊……梅林阁下，还有伊芙特使。
say:3:1711054002:1.male: It's you... Magister Merlin and Envoy Evie.
say:3:1711054002:1.female: It's you... Magister Merlin and Envoy Evie.

say:4:1711054003:1.text: ... I've already said everything there is to say. Are you here to humiliate a prisoner more?
say:4:1711054003:1.source_cn: ……该说的我都说了，你们还要继续羞辱一个阶下囚吗？

choice_prompt:5:1711054003.text: ... I've already said everything there is to say. Are you here to humiliate a prisoner more?
choice_prompt:5:1711054003.source_cn: ……该说的我都说了，你们还要继续羞辱一个阶下囚吗？

say:6:1711054004:1.text: What difference does it make? I'm nothing more than a prisoner, waiting endlessly for time to pass.
say:6:1711054004:1.source_cn: 悔改不悔改又能改变什么呢？现在的我只是一个永恒等待的囚徒。
say:6:1711054004:1.male: What difference does it make? I'm nothing more than a prisoner, waiting endlessly for time to pass.
say:6:1711054004:1.female: What difference does it make? I'm nothing more than a prisoner, waiting endlessly for time to pass.

say:7:1711054006:1.text: If this were just about the old case with Headmaster Leymar, that's already closed. But unfortunately, your testimony left out the most important part.
say:7:1711054006:1.source_cn: 如果只是为了雷蒙校长的旧案，那已经结案。但很遗憾，格墨...

say:8:1711054007:1.text: Left out? I already admitted I'm the killer. What else do you want?
say:8:1711054007:1.source_cn: 隐瞒？我已经承认我是凶手了，我还隐瞒了什么？

say:9:1711054008:1.text: Or do you want to hear me repent? That's the work of the Temple, not mages.
say:9:1711054008:1.source_cn: 难道你们想听我忏悔？那是圣堂的工作，不是魔法师的。

choice_prompt:10:1711054008.text: Or do you want to hear me repent? That's the work of the Temple, not mages.
choice_prompt:10:1711054008.source_cn: 难道你们想听我忏悔？那是圣堂的工作，不是魔法师的。

say:11:1711054009:1.text: In the previous interrogation, Gervan claimed that the Adamant Syndicate used "dark magic" to heal his legs.
say:11:1711054009:1.source_cn: 在之前的审讯里，格墨文只说是黑金商会用“黑魔法”治好了...

say:12:1711054010:1.text: But he never mentioned that limb regeneration of this magnitude is beyond common dark magic, nor did he mention Cyran's role in this.
say:12:1711054010:1.source_cn: 但他没有提过这种程度的肢体重生，根本不是普通黑魔法能做...

say:13:1711054011:1.text: ... Magister Merlin, you're really overstepping. These are my legs. Does it even matter how they got healed?
say:13:1711054011:1.source_cn: ……梅林阁下，您未免管得太宽了。腿长在我身上，是用什么...

say:8:1711059007:1.source_cn: 少说这些混账话！我、我一直在担心你！

say:9:1711059008:1.source_cn: 省省吧，不要浪费你那廉价的感情了。

say:10:1711059009:1.text: In the end, a criminal like me and a noble family's knight like you were never truly friends.
say:10:1711059009:1.source_cn: 说到底，罪人格墨文和骑士家族的休，根本算不上是朋友。

say:12:1711059010:1.text: Don't say that... Silven has always considered you a friend!
say:12:1711059010:1.source_cn: 你别这样说，格墨文……休一直把你当朋友！

say:15:1711059012:1.text:
Liar!
You've never told the truth, not back then, and not now!
say:15:1711059012:1.source_cn: 撒谎！\n你嘴里没有一句真话，过去没有，现在也没有！

say:16:1711059013:1.text: You fooled me once. I believed you didn't care about the rumors, that you could face everything calmly...
say:16:1711059013:1.source_cn: 我被你骗过，相信你真的不在乎家族里的流言蜚语，相信你真...

say:17:1711059014:1.text: But I won't be fooled again! Gervan, you coward!
say:17:1711059014:1.source_cn: 但如今，我不会再被你骗第二次！格墨文，你这个懦夫！

say:20:1711059016:1.text: Magister Merlin, did you bring me here for a boring class reunion? Because if so, I'd rather go back to my room.
say:20:1711059016:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，你是带我来参加这种无聊的同学聚会的吗？如果是...
say:20:1711059016:1.male: Magister Merlin, did you bring me here for a boring class reunion? Because if so, I'd rather go back to my room.
say:20:1711059016:1.female: Magister Merlin, did you bring me here for a boring class reunion? Because if so, I'd rather go back to my room.

say:23:1711059017:1.text: He knows how to open it?

say:23:1711059017:1.male: He knows how to open it?
say:23:1711059017:1.female: He knows how to open it?

choice_prompt:24:1711059017.female: He knows how to open it?

say:25:1711059018:1.text: You briefly explain: Gervan has been inside that space, and he practiced the same dark magic performed there.
say:25:1711059018:1.source_cn: 你简短地解释了原因，格墨文是进入过那个空间，且身上使用...
say:25:1711059018:1.male: You briefly explain: Gervan has been inside that space, and he practiced the same dark magic performed there.
say:25:1711059018:1.female: You briefly explain: Gervan has been inside that space, and he practiced the same dark magic performed there.

say:28:1711059020:1.text: If you help us open the chamber and get to the truth, I'll submit a report to the court recommending a lighter sentence.
say:28:1711059020:1.source_cn: 如果你能成功协助我们打开密室，查明真相，我会向法庭提交...

say:32:1711059023:1.text: For all we know, he's not trying to make amends. He might be planning to escape or destroy evidence. I'll keep an eye on him.
say:32:1711059023:1.source_cn: 这家伙心里想的可不一定是戴罪立功，说不定正在计划着逃跑...

choice:24:0:1.source_cn: 他进去过，在那里接受了禁术

choice:21:0:1.text: I need you to help open the hidden chamber.
choice:21:0:1.male: I need you to help open the hidden chamber.
choice:21:0:1.female: I need you to help open the hidden chamber.

say:0:1711061001:1.text: This is a massive study, forcibly carved out by spatial magic. A dark ritual circle is spread across the floor.
say:0:1711061001:1.source_cn: 这是一个被空间魔法强行开辟出的巨大研究室。最引人瞩目的...

say:1:1711061002:1.text: The walls are hidden behind towering shelves, crammed with notes, scrolls, and unlabeled specimen jars.
say:1:1711061002:1.source_cn: 四周的墙壁被无数高耸的书架包围，上面塞满了密密麻麻的笔...

say:2:1711061003:1.text: In the center of the room, a long workbench is cluttered with experimental equipment and unfinished manuscripts.
say:2:1711061003:1.source_cn: 在房间的正中，摆放着一张长桌，上面堆放着实验器具和尚未...

say:4:1711061004:1.text: So this is Cyran's hidden chamber... I can't believe he managed to hide an illegal space right under the Arcane Affairs Office's nose.
say:4:1711061004:1.source_cn: 这就是迪尔格雷的密室吗？居然在魔法事务司的眼皮底下，藏...

choice_prompt:5:1711061004.text: So this is Cyran's hidden chamber... I can't believe he managed to hide an illegal space right under the Arcane Affairs Office's nose.
choice_prompt:5:1711061004.source_cn: 这就是迪尔格雷的密室吗？居然在魔法事务司的眼皮底下，藏了这么大一个违禁空间。

say:6:1711061005:1.text: I'll check the bookshelves. I need to find the paper trail between him and the Adamant Syndicate.
say:6:1711061005:1.source_cn: 我去搜查周边的书架。我会重点寻找黑金商会的往来信件和账...

say:8:1711061006:1.text: I'll examine the research equipment and see if there are any dangerous forbidden magical items.
say:8:1711061006:1.source_cn: 我去查看研究器具，看看有没有威胁巨大的违禁魔法制品。

say:10:1711061007:1.text: If everyone's investigating, then I'll keep an eye on Gervan.
say:10:1711061007:1.source_cn: 既然大家都要调查，那就由我来负责看管格墨文吧。

say:11:1711061008:1.text: Suit yourself. I'm not going anywhere.

choice_prompt:12:1711061008.text: Suit yourself. I'm not going anywhere.

say:0:1711062001:0.text: I'll look for anything related to dark magic.
say:0:1711062001:0.source_cn: 我重点检查和禁术相关的东西。
say:0:1711062001:0.male: I'll look for anything related to dark magic.
say:0:1711062001:0.female: I'll look for anything related to dark magic.

say:1:1711062201:0.text: These experiments clearly revolve around dark magic.
say:1:1711062201:0.source_cn: 这里的实验对象看样子与禁术有关。

say:2:1711062202:1.text: Yet despite the sheer volume of the records, there isn't a single lie within them... nor the slightest trace of humanity.
say:2:1711062202:1.source_cn: 只不过这沉重的总录里，没有一句谎言，但也找不到一丝人性。

document:0:581:0.text:
[Evolution of Dark Magic]
Phase 1: <style="highlight">Flesh Binding Curse (Initial Form)</style>
Flaw: Can only be used between direct blood relatives, and the caster faces an immense risk of backlash.
Evaluation: Primitive, inefficient, and overly restrictive.

Phase 2: <style="highlight">Dark Transfer (Advanced Form)</style>
Breakthrough: Can now be used beyond direct blood relatives.
Flaw: The recipient must still "willingly" accept the repercussions.

Phase 3: <style="highlight">Dark Extraction (Perfected Form)</style>
... the third phase of research is nearing completion. Unlike the previous two phases, the spell can now extract power without consent.
No magical pact or consent is required. Once certain conditions are met, the recipient can forcibly transfer the repercussions and curse to a third party while stripping them of their power.

First Experiment (Completed)
Subject: <style="highlight">X (Emerson)</style>
Result: <style="highlight">Successful</style>
Procedure: Despite X's fierce resistance, the extraction was still successful. His mana was forcibly removed, draining his life force in an instant. His death was disguised as magical backlash. No one suspected a thing.

Ultimate Test
Subject: <style="highlight">M</style>
M meets every criterion for an ideal subject, from exceptionally pure mana circuits to an extraordinarily resilient soul. The only obstacles are the subject's immense mana reserves and exceptional mental fortitude.

Solution:
Construct an ultra-advanced empowerment magic circle and lure M into its core. This will suppress the flow of M's mana, making the extraction much easier.

Progress: <style="highlight">80%. The core runes have yet to be completed.</style>
Status: Cannot be activated yet
document:0:581:0.source_cn:
【禁咒演化综述】
阶段一：<style="highlight">血肉禁锢（原型）</style>
缺陷：仅限直系血亲使用，且施术者需承担巨大反噬风险。
评价：原始、低效，受限于血缘的枷锁。

阶段二：<style="highlight">黑暗转移（进阶）</style>
突破：移除了血亲限制。
缺陷：仍需受体“自愿”承担代价。

阶段三：<style="highlight">终极·黑暗掠夺</style>
……第三阶段的研究已接近尾声。不同于前两阶段的“血亲禁锢”与“黑暗转移”，真正的伟大，在于不经允许的“剥夺”。
无需契约，无需知情。只要满足特定条件，即可强制将自身的代价与诅咒转移给第三方，并反向掠夺其权能。

第一次实验（已完成）
实验对象：<style="highlight">样本 X（注：指埃摩森）</style>
实验结果：<style="highlight">成功。</style>
过程记录：“虽然样本 X 进行了激烈的魔力抵抗，但‘掠夺’依然生效。他的魔力源被强行剥离，生命力在一瞬间枯竭。死因被伪造成魔法反噬，无人怀疑。”

最终实验计划：
实验对象：<style="highlight">M</style>
拥有这个时代最完美的超凡特质。无论是魔力回路的纯净度，还是灵魂的韧性，都是最佳供体。缺点在于其魔力过于庞大，且精神防御极高。

解决方案：
构建一个超高阶的复合增幅法阵，配合诱饵将其引入阵眼，先压制其魔力活性，再进行掠夺。

当前状态：<style="highlight">法阵绘制完成80%（核心符文尚未闭环）</style>
状态：暂不可用

say:2:1711062302:1.text: That massive ritual circle... it was built for one final victim.
say:2:1711062302:1.source_cn: 那个占据了大半个房间的巨大暗红色法阵，原来有一个最终实...

say:1:1711064001:1.text: Magister Merlin, Envoy Evie, come take a look at this!
say:1:1711064001:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，伊芙大人，你们快来看看这个！
say:1:1711064001:1.male: Magister Merlin, Envoy Evie, come take a look at this!
say:1:1711064001:1.female: Magister Merlin, Envoy Evie, come take a look at this!

say:2:1711064002:1.text: I found these potions. After analyzing, they appear to be a variant of high-level mind control potions.
say:2:1711064002:1.source_cn: 我找到了这些药剂。经过简单的成分解析，这是高阶精神控制...

say:3:1711064003:1.text: And there's also this "Discarded Specimen Report". It details the disposal of a body that died after forced mana extraction.
say:3:1711064003:1.source_cn: 还有这份《废弃样本处理报告》，上面的记录显示此处曾处理...

say:4:1711064004:1.source_cn: 而那个受害者的名字——是埃摩森。

say:6:1711064005:1.text: Emerson was the same court mage who supposedly died in an accident a while back.
say:6:1711064005:1.source_cn: 如果我没猜错的话，这个埃摩森就是之前意外去世的宫廷魔法师。

say:7:1711064006:1.text: Back then, the Arcane Affairs Office stated he died during an experiment gone wrong. But that's clearly not the truth.
say:7:1711064006:1.source_cn: 当时，魔法事务司通报说，魔法师埃摩森因实验意外而身亡。...

say:8:1711064007:1.text: Emerson's "accident" perfectly matches the records and research you found. The truth is undeniable.
say:8:1711064007:1.source_cn: 埃摩森的事故与你发现的论文和记录完全对应，真相已经昭然...
say:8:1711064007:1.male: Emerson's "accident" perfectly matches the records and research you found. The truth is undeniable.

say:26:1711068022:1.female: You sigh, looking her in the eye as you draw your line in the sand.

say:27:1711068023:1.text: You tell Gwendolyn that if there's a way, you will save Maximilian. But you will never use the kind of dark magic Cyran relied on—magic built on plunder and sacrifice.
say:27:1711068023:1.source_cn: 你告诉莫德琳，如果有办法的话，你会救马克西姆。但你绝不...
say:27:1711068023:1.male: You tell Gwendolyn that if there's a way, you will save Maximilian. But you will never use the kind of dark magic Cyran relied on—magic built on plunder and sacrifice.
say:27:1711068023:1.female: You tell Gwendolyn that if there's a way, you will save Maximilian. But you will never use the kind of dark magic Cyran relied on—magic built on plunder and sacrifice.

say:28:1711068024:1.text: I knew you would say that. If you had agreed immediately, you wouldn't be the Merlin I know.
say:28:1711068024:1.source_cn: 我就知道你会这么说。如果你刚才一口答应，那才不是我认识...
say:28:1711068024:1.male: I knew you would say that. If you had agreed immediately, you wouldn't be the Merlin I know.
say:28:1711068024:1.female: I knew you would say that. If you had agreed immediately, you wouldn't be the Merlin I know.

say:29:1711068025:1.text: Since we've both rejected Cyran's method, that leaves only one path—
say:29:1711068025:1.source_cn: 既然我们都否决了迪尔格雷的方案，那就只剩下一条路了——
say:29:1711068025:1.male: Since we've both rejected Cyran's method, that leaves only one path—
say:29:1711068025:1.female: Since we've both rejected Cyran's method, that leaves only one path—

say:30:1711068026:1.text: We'll do it ourselves and refine the dark magic.
say:30:1711068026:1.source_cn: 我们自己来，我们来改良禁术。
say:30:1711068026:1.male: We'll do it ourselves and refine the dark magic.
say:30:1711068026:1.female: We'll do it ourselves and refine the dark magic.

choice_prompt:31:1711068026.text: We'll do it ourselves and refine the dark magic.
choice_prompt:31:1711068026.source_cn: 我们自己来，我们来改良禁术。
choice_prompt:31:1711068026.male: We'll do it ourselves and refine the dark magic.
choice_prompt:31:1711068026.female: We'll do it ourselves and refine the dark magic.

say:32:1711068027:1.text: Then let us collaborate once more.
say:32:1711068027:1.source_cn: 好！那就让我们再合作一次吧，梅林。
say:32:1711068027:1.male: Then let us collaborate once more.
say:32:1711068027:1.female: Then let us collaborate once more.

say:33:1711068028:1.text: This reminds me of twenty years ago... back when we would spend whole nights arguing, experimenting, and calculating to crack a magical theory.
say:33:1711068028:1.source_cn: 这让我想起了二十多年前……那时候我们也是为了攻克一个魔...
say:33:1711068028:1.male: This reminds me of twenty years ago... back when we would spend whole nights arguing, experimenting, and calculating to crack a magical theory.
say:33:1711068028:1.female: This reminds me of twenty years ago... back when we would spend whole nights arguing, experimenting, and calculating to crack a magical theory.

say:34:1711068029:1.text: You may not remember because of your amnesia, but it doesn't matter. We can make new memories.
say:34:1711068029:1.source_cn: 虽然因为失忆，你可能已经不记得那些日子了，但没关系……...
say:34:1711068029:1.male: You may not remember because of your amnesia, but it doesn't matter. We can make new memories.
say:34:1711068029:1.female: You may not remember because of your amnesia, but it doesn't matter. We can make new memories.

say:35:1711068030:1.text: In fact, shall we make a wager? Let's see who can first devise a stable, refined version of that array.
say:35:1711068030:1.source_cn: 顺便，我们打个赌如何？看谁能最快解析出那个法阵的改良版……
say:35:1711068030:1.male: In fact, shall we make a wager? Let's see who can first devise a stable, refined version of that array.
say:35:1711068030:1.female: In fact, shall we make a wager? Let's see who can first devise a stable, refined version of that array.

say:36:1711068031:1.text: And whoever loses must grant the winner one request.
say:36:1711068031:1.source_cn: 如果谁输了，可是要答应对方一个条件的。
say:36:1711068031:1.male: And whoever loses must grant the winner one request.
say:36:1711068031:1.female: And whoever loses must grant the winner one request.

choice_prompt:37:1711068031.text: And whoever loses must grant the winner one request.
choice_prompt:37:1711068031.source_cn: 如果谁输了，可是要答应对方一个条件的。
choice_prompt:37:1711068031.male: And whoever loses must grant the winner one request.
choice_prompt:37:1711068031.female: And whoever loses must grant the winner one request.

say:38:1711068032:1.text: In that case, I'll be the witness!
say:38:1711068032:1.source_cn: 既然如此，那就由我来做见证人！

say:39:1711068033:1.text: Then let us begin, and see who claims victory in the end.
say:39:1711068033:1.source_cn: 那就从现在开始，看看谁才是最终的胜者。
say:39:1711068033:1.male: Then let us begin, and see who claims victory in the end.
say:39:1711068033:1.female: Then let us begin, and see who claims victory in the end.

say:40:1711068034:1.text: This time, I won't lose to you.
say:40:1711068034:1.source_cn: 梅林，这一次，我可不会再输给你。
say:40:1711068034:1.male: This time, I won't lose to you.
say:40:1711068034:1.female: This time, I won't lose to you.

narration:41:1711068035:1.text: With the wager made, the two of you throw yourselves into your research. In the days that follow, the Royal Library and the Mystical House remain illuminated deep into the night.
narration:41:1711068035:1.male: With the wager made, the two of you throw yourselves into your research. In the days that follow, the Royal Library and the Mystical House remain illuminated deep into the night.
narration:41:1711068035:1.female: With the wager made, the two of you throw yourselves into your research. In the days that follow, the Royal Library and the Mystical House remain illuminated deep into the night.

narration:42:1711068036:1.text: Cyran's papers are dismantled and analyzed piece by piece, as you attempt to reconstruct a path to life from the twisted circuits of the dark magic...
narration:42:1711068036:1.male: Cyran's papers are dismantled and analyzed piece by piece, as you attempt to reconstruct a path to life from the twisted circuits of the dark magic...
narration:42:1711068036:1.female: Cyran's papers are dismantled and analyzed piece by piece, as you attempt to reconstruct a path to life from the twisted circuits of the dark magic...

choice:37:1:2.text: No backing out when you lose.
choice:37:1:2.male: No backing out when you lose.
choice:37:1:2.female: No backing out when you lose.

choice:31:1:2.text: Anything Cyran does, I can do better.
choice:31:1:2.source_cn: 相信我，我比迪尔格雷更强
choice:31:1:2.male: Anything Cyran does, I can do better.
choice:31:1:2.female: Anything Cyran does, I can do better.

choice:24:1:2.text: I won't help you use dark magic.
choice:24:1:2.source_cn: 我不会协助你使用黑魔法
choice:24:1:2.male: I won't help you use dark magic.
choice:24:1:2.female: I won't help you use dark magic.

choice:20:0:1.text: Even if it costs you your lifespan? Even your life?
choice:20:0:1.source_cn: 哪怕是折损寿命，甚至失去生命吗？
choice:20:0:1.male: Even if it costs you your lifespan? Even your life?
choice:20:0:1.female: Even if it costs you your lifespan? Even your life?

choice:11:1:2.text: There are countless people who still need you.
choice:11:1:2.male: There are countless people who still need you.
choice:11:1:2.female: There are countless people who still need you.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1711005101:.text: These paperwork stacks are taller than me...
cinematic_dialogue:1:1711005101:.source_cn: 这些文书堆起来比我还高……

cinematic_dialogue:1:1711005201:.text: There's no way I can finish this!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1711032002:.text: Who's going to compensate me for this?!

say:4:1711036004:1.text: However, this only caused a little trouble and was not enough to delay the investigation for too long.
say:4:1711036004:1.source_cn: 但这只是稍微制造了一点麻烦，并不足以拖延太多的调查进度。

choice_prompt:21:1711048013.source_cn: 您想到自爆身份的奥瑞利安，忍不住想要用他来试探一下埃德加。

say:19:1711056016:1.text: ...Now that you already know, were you just toying with me?
say:19:1711056016:1.source_cn: ……既然你们已经知道了，那刚才的一切都是在玩弄我吗？
